purpose: Qualify actual authored-body gravity/damping operator before any separately registered predictive contact response. StageA retained-linear fails its physical gate; it is not repaired by this oracle.
context: Preliminary and complete StageA show retained-linear support speeds near the per-step gravity increment, increased sinking, and baseline contact-phase oscillation. No-contact operator isolates engine integration without native coupling or controller work.
inputs: Fresh private actual Rapier session for every case. Preserve authored shape/mass/inertia/gravity_scale/damping coefficients and combine/replace modes. One zero-gravity/zero-motion prime, then restore original gravity and set the declared initial motion. No controller advance, coupling, forces, impulses, other bodies, hard terrain or Area overrides. Keep awake. No outcome fitting.
observe: Every before/after lossless pose/velocity/omega/COM state; direct total gravity/linear damping/angular damping/step/contact count; source project/body properties; nominal sampled gravity; manual step index exactly+1; actual KE and position. Extra copies/timings/source/runtime/host identities and teardown retained.
interpretation: Compute all models in float64 and separately explicit float32 arithmetic, using measured before-step total gravity/damping and declared1/60dt; record actual reported step separately. Freeze equations before new outcomes. No fitted multiplier, model substitution, retiming or damping change.

gate.scope: Report one-step and full32step errors for every model/case/host. Compatibility is max one-step velocity/omega error<=1e-5 over all declared observations, with valid finite properties, zero contacts and complete coverage. This is not contact acceptance, native passivity or original SOL clearance. Models can all fail; missing properties are UNAVAILABLE, never zero-filled.
